temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. He also hears Gary decline the weekend retreat because there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is a dedicated and hardworking friend, but he has become worried that Gary's recent overwork may be harming his health.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's refusal confirms that the work pressure is severe and that Gary is not currently willing or able to step away for rest.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is seriously overcommitted and at risk of burnout, and that simple encouragement to take a break may not be enough.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, and empathetic, with some disappointment or frustration.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To keep supporting Gary and look for a way to help him address his health without adding more pressure.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes that Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work. Ethan begins to suspect there is more to Gary's overworking than professional obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is seriously overworked and was reluctant to take time away, but he hoped the retreat might help Gary relax and open up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's restlessness and avoidance make Ethan suspect hidden personal or emotional reasons behind the overwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary's overwork is complicated and that Gary is carrying something significant he has not shared.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront Gary gently, reassure him that he can speak freely, and offer help without judgment.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After the confrontation, Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges. Gary also agrees that help with organizing his schedule would be useful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is hiding a deeper problem and wants Gary to open up so he can understand and help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's disclosure explains the overwork as connected to new departmental pressure and personal challenges, and Gary's agreement shows he is willing to accept support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes he now understands why Gary has been overworking and that Gary can find a better balance with practical support and delegation.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relieved and empathetic, with compassion for Gary's pressures.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule so he can make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan checks in with Gary and sees Gary making efforts to change. Gary reports feeling less overwhelmed and even had time for a movie.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has understood the need for balance and is willing to work on it, but Ethan is still monitoring whether the changes will hold.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's reported progress and visible efforts confirm that the support and changes are helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is improving, becoming less overwhelmed, and moving toward a healthier work-life balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, offering encouragement, and being available whenever Gary needs to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Ethan sees that Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance, feels more in control, and can manage on his own. Gary thanks Ethan for his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been making steady progress and still benefits from regular support and encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's sustained adjustment and sense of control confirm that he can now manage independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary no longer needs active intervention and is capable of maintaining his healthier balance, though Ethan remains a supportive friend.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active support while letting Gary know he is always available if needed.
